title: files_upload_v2 fails with invalid_channel when given a channel name or user ID
symptoms: The same channel value worked with the old files_upload
Uploaded file exists but is shared to no channel when channel is omitted
cause: The v2 helpers call files.completeUploadExternal, which accepts only a conversation ID, not a channel name or a user ID. Slack maintainers confirmed name support was left out on purpose. With no channel the file is uploaded but stays private.
fix: Resolve the conversation ID first. For a DM, open it with conversations.open and pass the returned channel ID.
affected: python-slack-sdk 3.19 and later, Node filesUploadV2, Java uploadV2; all versions as of 2026-10
